prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Companion Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a centered spotlight view featuring companion selection cards for instant decision making.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "path_options", "style": "playful", "text": "Choose your starter companion mode"}]}}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone Sign In After Certificate: Move the sign_in screen to occur after adoption certificate completion before waiting for desktop rendering.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Centered Redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen into a centered spotlight layout with clear name input and official adoption badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "replace": {"certificate": [{"type": "name_input", "role": "certificate", "label": "Name your companion", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "badge", "role": "certificate", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Progress Display: Add visual progress tracking and time estimation components to the waiting screen while desktop pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Preparing your pet companion for desktop launch...", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Arrival Control Spotlight Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a spotlight layout featuring prominent interaction control cards right upon desktop arrival.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "home_welcome", "text": "Desktop Pet Controls: Click to pet, drag to move, right-click menu to hide", "style": "playful"}]}}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Reassurance Guidance Hint: Display an inline hint on choose_path explaining that pet path choices can be changed later from app settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can add more pets or change companion modes anytime in settings."}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Data Protection Hint: Add an explicit persistence hint on sign_in explaining that account creation saves pet data to the cloud.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in binds your pet securely to your account so companion progress is never lost."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Rendering Guidance Hint: Provide practical photo quality guidelines on the upload_photos screen to prevent custom generation errors.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload a clear, well-lit photo with full face visible for accurate pet companion generation."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop notification alerts when companion pet generation finishes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet companion is ready!", "style": "calm"}]}}
9: [finish, incentive] Finish Step Quick Start Action Buttons: Add an interactive action button on home_intro encouraging immediate first pet interaction on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Say Hello to Your Desktop Pet", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}

verdicts.reason: The choose_path replacement fails to offer both adopting and making your own pet.
Reordering sign_in within onboarding is allowed and preserves all steps.
Replacing the certificate elements removes the official stamp requirement.
Adding progress and time estimation to the waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning home_intro layout and components inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding guidance hints on choose_path within onboarding is allowed.
Adding a sign-in data persistence hint is allowed and informative.
Adding photo upload guidelines inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding notification prompts on the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding an interactive action button to home_intro is allowed.
